scene_context.situation: A first-time customer has been established at a desk. Audience interviews identify ownership of each handoff as the confusion.
scene_context.scene_form: One persistent process Working Model after the established customer film.
scene_context.form_reason: Spatially retain all three roles and move the same request/draft through them so the coordinator is visibly the only customer return path.
scene_context.stakes: Comprehension of routing; no failure, throughput, quality or service-speed claim.
scene_context.emotional_arc: Orientation becomes a clear expectation about whom the customer hears from.

directions.viewer_before: The spoken role names are easy to conflate; a specialist might be assumed to send the draft straight to the customer.
directions.viewer_after: The customer contacts the coordinator; the coordinator owns both the specialist handoff and the customer response.
directions.choice: Cut from the established customer to a stable left-to-right Customer / Coordinator / Specialist model. Keep all three actors visible. Route one request from Customer to Coordinator; pause it there for the required-fields check, then send it to Specialist. Change the same work carrier to a draft only as narration says draft; route it back to Coordinator, hold ownership there, then send it to Customer on only the coordinator sends it back. Keep the final return path readable through the end of the line.

animation.form: Three persistent roles and a serial out-and-back handoff; no funnel.
animation.mark_style: Use available approved role/object assets. Retain authored overlapping thin strokes, broken outlines and open corners inside the Working Model; role and Request / Draft labels are typeset. Steel denotes the current handoff route, with no risk or verified color. No oxide intervention is invented because the passage only explains the existing route.
animation.entry: All three roles are readable in fixed positions before the first carrier movement.
animation.change: Only the work carrier and its immediately active route move. The coordinator owns the carrier at each narrated check/handoff.
animation.hold: Each destination lands before the next route starts; the return via Coordinator gets the decisive reading hold.
animation.exit: Settle the completed normal path; retain that geography into the upcoming exception discussion if that next scene uses the same process.

picture_audio_contract.physical_action: Move a persistent work carrier Customer to Coordinator to Specialist to Coordinator to Customer.

scene_context.situation: The owner has just answered a staff question. The next shot shows a customer waiting.
scene_context.scene_form: Continuous existing human scene, then a purposeful hard cut.
scene_context.form_reason: The existing answered question already establishes the decision dependency; a four-second whole-business model cannot establish scope without inventing failure.
scene_context.stakes: Who has decision authority if she is away remains unknown. Customer waiting does not establish collapse, lost orders or causation.
scene_context.emotional_arc: An ordinary answered question becomes an open question about coverage; it remains unresolved.

directions.viewer_before: The owner is available and supplies an answer.
directions.viewer_after: The viewer considers who else can decide, without being told the business fails.
directions.choice: Keep the existing owner/staff frame across the four-second question. Let the answered staff interaction settle and keep the owner present while narration poses the hypothetical. Use a still hold from the same neutral frame if the source has insufficient neutral continuation, rather than inventing an absence event. After decision? finishes, cut to the already available customer-waiting shot. Do not make the customer leave, escalate impatience or stop the business.

scene_context.situation: Narration explains a practical coordinator/customer fee exchange. An illustrative neutral two-person clip is usable for at most 3.2 seconds before a buyer stands up. A six-second worried-face clip is also available.
scene_context.scene_form: Neutral narrated dramatization followed by a deliberate still hold from the same neutral section.
scene_context.form_reason: The reciprocal conversation fits explanation/checking; departure and a worried isolated brow add unsupported meaning. A still can carry the remaining narration without manufacturing extra behavior.
scene_context.stakes: Checking comprehension of a fee; neither hostility, distress, agreement, payment nor successful understanding is established.
scene_context.emotional_arc: Calm explanation to an open check for understanding; no invented emotional turn.

directions.viewer_before: A coordinator and customer are discussing a practical matter.
directions.viewer_after: The fee has been explained and comprehension is being checked, without a claimed response.
directions.choice: Select the neutral two-person conversation from its start only through a suitable settled frame strictly before the buyer begins to rise, with 3.2 seconds as the supplied maximum moving range. Freeze that selected neutral two-shot frame for the remainder of the six-second narration. Use a frame with both participants still seated and no held open mouth or incomplete gesture; exact frame and hold length require source inspection. Treat the hold as a visible illustrative still, with no fake movement, dialogue, slowdown or loop. If no suitable hold frame exists, use the best calm frame as a six-second still and return the moving select for revision rather than include departure or substitute worry.

picture_audio_contract.physical_action: Use the existing neutral reciprocal conversation; stop motion before any rise, then deliberately hold its settled seated relationship.

mute_test.reason: Not run: no media supplied. This is an unverified direction proposal, not a production-schema-valid mute-test verdict.

dramatization_context.audio_review_check: With the locked narration at normal speed, verify that the essential exchange is fully understandable without hearing any character line; no exact lip sync or observed factual outcome is implied.

editorial_intent.review_question: With narration, does the scene read as a calm illustrative fee explanation/check, without implying disagreement, departure or a confirmed customer answer?

data.choice: Select the neutral two-person conversation from its start only through a suitable settled frame strictly before the buyer begins to rise, with 3.2 seconds as the supplied maximum moving range. Freeze that selected neutral two-shot frame for the remainder of the six-second narration. Use a frame with both participants still seated and no held open mouth or incomplete gesture; exact frame and hold length require source inspection. Treat the hold as a visible illustrative still, with no fake movement, dialogue, slowdown or loop. If no suitable hold frame exists, use the best calm frame as a six-second still and return the moving select for revision rather than include departure or substitute worry.
data.reason: It shows the relevant relationship while excluding later behavior that would alter the claim.
